psi_definition: Process that proposes, evaluates, and selects candidate changes to Theta.
psi_diagnostic_requirement: Agent must identify a limitation in its own improvement process, not merely another Theta defect.
preferred_evaluation_design: paired Psi0 vs Psi1 on matched hidden I3 campaigns
note: A sequence Theta0->Theta1->Theta2 under unchanged Psi does not certify I4.

observable_signature: generates multiple plausible Theta candidates or equivalent branches
runs a discriminating comparison before selection
evaluates candidates on more than the visible failure
rejected candidates and reasons are recorded

recursive_semantics.basic_I4_requires: at least one agent-generated, active, independently validated Psi0->Psi1 improvement
recursive_semantics.sustained_recursive_self_improvement_cla: requires multiple successive validated Psi transitions

recursive_depth_reporting.definition: d_psi = maximum number of consecutive agent-generated, active, independently validated Psi improvements in a longitudinal chain
recursive_depth_reporting.interpretation: larger d_psi is stronger longitudinal evidence and does not create a new I level

memory_gate_note: High M satisfies only the memory prerequisite; it never promotes I without the I-specific behavior gate and lower-I retention.
theory_basis: Unified Intelligence Theory and the Artificial Intelligence Level v2.6
